title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
locationText: Ukraine | Romania | Poland | Sweden | Portugal | Slovakia | Bulgaria | Italy | Croatia | Slovenia | Belgium | Denmark | Estonia | Spain | Czechia | Ukraine
description:
SENIOR FULL-STACK ENGINEER (PYTHON + TYPESCRIPT)

We are looking for a skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer, with a main focus on the back-end, to join our team and help build AI-driven products from the early stage.



ABOUT THE PROJECT:

Our client is a global professional services firm specialising in cloud enablement and digital transformation. The company helps organisations accelerate innovation through cutting-edge cloud, data, and AI solutions.

They are establishing a new delivery unit focused on Data and AI projects. The existing team consists of strong AI/ML experts, and the new group will strengthen application development capabilities: building intuitive front-ends and scalable cloud services around the company's AI-driven solutions.

This is an opportunity to join at an early stage, help shape the technical foundation, and work on projects that apply artificial intelligence to real-world business challenges.



ABOUT THE PRODUCT:

The product is an employee development and engagement platform with an AI chat, Microsoft Teams integration, and an internal admin panel.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 - Develop the back-end in Python (FastAPI) and the BFF layer in Node.js/TypeScript.

 - Work on the AI chat built on Azure OpenAI and LangChain.

 - Build features in Angular, and in React for the admin panel.

 - Implement integrations: Microsoft Entra ID, Teams, Twilio, Courier, Google APIs.

 - Work within a SOC 2 process: PR reviews, secure logging, and secrets control.





REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5+ years of commercial software development experience, including Python (FastAPI, async, Pydantic) and MongoDB.

 - TypeScript: Node.js/Express and Angular.

 - Docker, Git, pytest/Jest.

 - REST, JWT, WebSocket.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with LLMs and Azure OpenAI.

 - Microsoft Entra ID, MSAL, Graph API, Teams bots.

 - React + Vite + Tailwind.

 - GCP, Terraform.

 - SOC 2 experience.


WHAT WE OFFER:

 - Flexible work environment: opportunity to work remotely.

 - 1:1 English classes: individual English language training.

 - Premium medical insurance: comprehensive health insurance.

 - Great team: a supportive, collaborative, and dynamic international team.

 - Equipment provided: all necessary equipment supplied.

 - Accounting support: full accounting assistance in Ukraine and Poland.

 - Paid time off: 18 days of annual vacation and 7 days of sick leave without a doctor's note.

 - Flexible payment system: a convenient payment solution with multiple withdrawal options.

If this sounds like you, send us your CV and let's talk. We would be happy to tell you more about the project and the team!

title: Engineering Manager - Portugal
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.


Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.




If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

 

Location: Portugal | Compensation package: €75,000 to €95,000 base + Bonus + Share Options + Benefits | Ways of working: remote with quarterly visits to our London office



What you will be doing

 - Lead 2x teams of 6-8 engineers, each including a Tech Lead and set the standard for how they deliver

 - Raise engineering and operational excellence, holding a high bar for system performance, quality and maintainability

 - Shape technical direction and influence architectural decisions in partnership with Tech Leads and Staff Engineers

 - Own delivery outcomes end to end, working with Product, Data and Marketing to shape objectives and align execution

 - Grow engineers and Tech Leads into their next level through coaching, mentoring and timely, constructive feedback

 - Improve how the team works, from decision-making to product team maturity, so every quarter runs better than the last
   
    

What you will need to be successful

 - You have led multiple teams as an Engineering Manager before - confident running multiples team of 5-8 engineers, with a track record of growing individuals and shipping impactful products

 - You bring technical depth - A significant background in backend engineering and experience with distributed systems, so you carry credibility in technical discussions and reviews

 - You are outcome-oriented - You solve real user and business problems rather than shipping features, keep the team aligned to measurable goals and take ownership of execution, knowing when to escalate and unblock

 - You are a confident people leader - You support growth through mentoring and development conversations and you give feedback that is timely, respectful and focused on helping people grow

 - You are a great communicator - You simplify complex topics for non-technical stakeholders and help cross-functional partners make good decisions quickly

 - You work AI-first - You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable

 
 


THE ZEGO WAYS OF WORKING 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QKOYDx6AMxQ.




BENEFITS 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.



Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Senior Game Developer - Paper.io2
locationText: Barcelona | Madrid | Warsaw | Tallinn | Karkiv | Malta | Helsinki | Stockholm | Istanbul | Lisboa | Berlin | Tbilisi | Amsterdam | Milan | Krakow | Bucharest | London | Kiev | Spain
description:
ABOUT VOODOO

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be fully remote within CET +/-2h.



TEAM

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.voodoo.paper2&hl=en_US.

With Paper.io 2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.




ROLE

We are looking for a talented Senior Game Developer with a good understanding of the casual mobile game market to help the team deliver fun, innovative, and entertaining features. You will take an innovative approach to gameplay ideas/features and give them their own spin.

 - Responsibilities will align with your strengths

 - Develop client-facing features

 - Work on core gameplay improvements

 - Develop new meta features

 - Enhance and refine existing systems

With this role, you will have a strong impact on the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a senior, multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people.  Flesh out the details of a game's design, oversee its testing, and revise the game in response to player feedback. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games.




PROFILE

 - 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Unity

 - Proven track record in successful mobile game development

 - Exceptional expertise in a specialized area (e.g., animation, particle systems, shaders, architecture, performance optimization or networking) is a major plus

 - Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on optimization and performance

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

 - A creative, hands-on developer with a passion for quality work




BENEFITS

 - Best-in-class compensation

 - Other benefits according to the country you reside

title: Senior Backend Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
locationText: Germany | Poland | Portugal | France | United Kingdom | Spain | Italy | The Netherlands | Germany
description:
About the Team

The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole.

You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog:

 - GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickpipes-gcp-pub-sub-preview

 - Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available https://clickhouse.com/blog/terraform-ga

 - Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickpipes-gcs-unordered-mode

We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production.

What will you do?

 - Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage.

 - Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements.

 - Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience.

 - Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents.

About you:

 - 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems.

 - Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem.

 - Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery.

 - Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider.

 - Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems.

 - Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering and product teams.

 - Experience with data ingestion pipelines, streaming platforms, or object storage is a plus.


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here https://clickhouse.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice for our Privacy Statement.

description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Solutions Engineer, you will be the primary technical partner for our Enterprise sales engagements. You’ll work closely with Account Executives to guide prospects through technical discovery, product evaluations, and proofs of concept — helping them validate that n8n can operate securely, reliably, and at scale in their environment.

This is a customer-facing, hands-on role focused on complex Enterprise use cases. You will spend your time working directly with technical stakeholders, leading technical conversations, and ensuring Enterprise customers clearly understand how n8n fits into their systems and processes.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Lead Enterprise technical discovery, deep-dive calls, and tailored demos, showing how n8n fits into complex customer environments while addressing security, scalability, and reliability requirements

 - Partner closely with Account Executives to assess technical fit, shape deal strategy, and handle technical objections, delivering demos grounded in real Enterprise workflows and use cases

 - Own Enterprise POCs end-to-end, from scoping success criteria to hands-on technical guidance throughout the evaluation

 - Help customers validate n8n in real-world conditions and capture POC learnings to improve qualification, conversion, and handoff to Solution Architecture/Customer Success

 - Build strong relationships with IT, Security, Platform, and Engineering stakeholders, acting as the primary technical contact during Enterprise evaluations

 - Clearly explain n8n’s approach to security, deployment, governance, and scale, helping customers plan adoption beyond their first use case

 - Collaborate with Sales to improve Enterprise technical discovery, demos, and POC frameworks

 - Provide structured feedback from Enterprise customers to Product and Engineering, and contribute to enablement materials that strengthen Enterprise sales motions
   
   


MUST-HAVE

💼 Sales Engineering Experience: You have 6+ years of experience in a technical pre-sales or Sales Engineering role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with direct exposure to enterprise customers

🗣 Excellent Communication Skills: You can clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and confidently engage with enterprise stakeholders

🌐 Commercial Acumen: You understand sales processes and can creatively translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions

🤝 Relationship Building: You excel at building and maintaining relationships with clients, particularly within infrastructure teams on deployment requirements

🔧 Strong Technical Proficiency: You bring hands-on experience with:

 - API integrations, OAuth, and authentication/authorization concepts

 - JavaScript and/or Python for scripting, integrations, or demos

 - Containerization and orchestration concepts (Docker, Kubernetes)

 - CI/CD and DevOps practices, including integrating applications into CI/CD pipelines

 - Networking fundamentals, security best practices, and observability concepts

☁️ Cloud & Infrastructure Awareness: You have a solid understanding of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and common cloud services used in modern SaaS architectures

🚀 Startup Experience: You thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership startup environments and enjoy wearing multiple hats

✈️ Travel-Ready: You’re open to occasional travel and onboarding sessions with the team in EMEA as needed




NICE-TO-HAVE

 - 🤖 AI & Automation Experience: Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with AI/LLM platforms, including concepts such as:
   
   - LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), agents, and orchestration frameworks
   
   - Integrating AI capabilities into workflows or customer-facing solutions
   
   - Exposure to ML infrastructure or AI-enabled automation platforms

 - 🎓 Advanced Technical Background: You hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical training

 - 🌱 Community & Open Source Engagement: You are active in technical communities or have experience contributing to or working with open-source projects

 - 🛠 Product Familiarity: Experience with n8n or similar workflow automation, integration, or iPaaS tools

 - 📊 Data-Driven Mindset: You’re comfortable collecting, analyzing, and using data to improve pre-sales processes, POCs, and customer outcomes

title: Solution Engineer III (French Speaking)
description:
About us
GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.
Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.
The role
You will be joining our Solution Engineering team and will be the primary technical lead during engagements with our prospective and existing merchants. You will help qualify, shape, close and support new and existing business opportunities. You will provide technical guidance and oversight on our most exciting opportunities whilst working alongside our sales teams.
Your day-to-day will focus on:
• Working with our French sales team on new and existing opportunities
• Presenting and crafting demos showcasing our product
• Performing technical discovery and architecting solution designs for prospects
• Work closely with our product team on product improvements, new initiatives and feature requests
• Work alongside implementation managers and customer success teams to ensure a smooth journey for clients
• Build and deliver demos and proofs of concept that show how bank payments work
What you’ll bring
Essential:
• Experience as a pre-sales, post-sales or implementation engineer working directly with customers or partners
• Hands-on API experience: you’re comfortable in Postman, reading logs and debugging a failing request
• A solid understanding of how APIs and MCP servers work
• Fluency in French and English
A Real Advantage:
• Experience building integrations with payment service providers or platforms
• Knowledge of payments, eg. Direct Debit, open banking, cards and alternative payment methods
• Day-to-day use of AI tools in your own engineering work
You’ll probably enjoy this role if
• You’re a problem solver who likes getting stuck into the detail
• You’re curious and learn new systems quickly
• You like being consultative, asking good questions before proposing answers
• You get a kick out of helping partners grow and build something new
Salary range - €48,000 - €72,000 + 30% OTE
Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff
• Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
• Lunch - based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office
• Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period
• Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
• Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
• Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
• Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house
Life at GoCardless
We're an organisation defined by our values ; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen , working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity , always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.
Diversity & Inclusion
As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.
To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:
Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%
Neurodiverse — 9%
LGBTQIA+ — 9%
Disabled — 1%
Average age — 33
Female — 45%
Male — 55%
We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.
If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here
Sustainability
We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.
Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter , Instagram and LinkedIn .

description:
About Dashlane
Dashlane is transforming credential security for the modern enterprise. Built on the Dashlane Secure Cloud and powered by a proprietary AI model, the Dashlane Omnix® platform goes beyond the password vault to protect credentials where the workforce actually uses them—in the browser. Millions of consumers and 25,000 organizations worldwide, including brands such as Michelin, Air France and Forrester, trust Dashlane for industry-leading innovations, patented zero-knowledge security and an unmatched user experience. Learn more at dashlane.com .
Being a Dashlaner means we Drive innovation and Value learning, Strive for excellence in everything we do, and Thrive as one Dashlane team. Dashlaners share ideas openly, hold each other accountable, and celebrate wins together.
We move fast because our customers' security depends on it. If you like solving hard problems, learning out loud, and collaborating closely with others, you'll feel at home as a Dashlaner.
About the role
The Sharing & Vault team is responsible for how people securely store and share credentials. The team works on sensitive product surfaces at the heart of credential security, balancing strong zero-knowledge principles with simple, reliable experiences for users and admins.
As a senior web engineer, you will shape intuitive, trustworthy interfaces and the client-side foundations behind them, turning security requirements into polished product experiences that are scalable, accessible, and easy to use. You will own complex features from design to production, mentor teammates, and help shape the team's technical direction.
Location-Specific Information:
You will be based in Paris, with English as your working language. At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.
Our stack:
•
Frontend: TypeScript, React, RxJS
•
Delivery and monitoring: GitLab, GitLab CI, ELK, Datadog
•
Tooling: Webpack, Vite, pnpm, Vitest, Puppeteer
•
Collaboration: Confluence, Zoom, Slack
•
AI: Claude Code
In your role, you will:
•
Take shared ownership of the team's product and technical choices, bringing creative ideas that make secure sharing and storage simpler for millions of users.
•
Collaborate with Product and Design to shape features from early discovery through delivery, to find the simplest, most impactful solutions for our users.
•
Partner with Security to write threat models and embed security considerations throughout design and implementation.
•
Implement projects end-to-end: write clean code, easy to maintain and understand, implement tests, and manage deployment.
•
Lean on AI coding platforms like Claude Code to streamline the SDLC, driving development velocity while maintaining high code quality.
•
Lead the technical design of complex features, review and guide your teammates' work, and partner with Staff engineers on cross-team topics and the evolution of our web foundations.
•
Learn every day, and share your knowledge with your co-workers.
Requirements:
•
7+ years of experience in software development including 5+ years building web applications.
•
Strong expertise in TypeScript, experience with React and modern state management.
•
Experience working in a product development team with agile practices.
•
Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and delivery including monorepos, bundlers, CI/CD pipelines, end-to-end tests and monitoring in production.
•
A strong focus on quality and an interest in client-side security topics (XSS, isolation, handling sensitive data in the browser).
•
Hands-on experience with AI engineering patterns, using GenAI tools in day-to-day development.
•
Fluent in English.
What Dashlane offers you:
• Parental Leave & Family Support: 26 weeks fully paid leave for birthing parents, and 16 weeks fully paid leave + 4-week transition period for non-birthing parents, and access to a spot in daycare through Babilou’s network.
• Health & Wellness: Receive comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents, access to Spring Health mental health services, four dedicated well-being days each year, and the Gymlib (Wellpass) corporate fitness and wellness program.
• Time to Recharge: Maintain a healthy work-life balance with around 35 vacation days per year (25 paid vacation days + ~10 additional RTT rest days) and a Time-Off Saving Account (CET) allowing you to save unused time off for later or have it paid out.
